name: Skywise Fleet Performance+
summary: Airbus predictive maintenance and reliability service combining aircraft data and predictive analytics, with NLP that detects repetitive faults; JetBlue signed in April 2026.
paragraphs: Airbus predictive maintenance and reliability service combining aircraft data and predictive analytics, with NLP that detects repetitive faults; JetBlue signed in April 2026.
whyItMatters: The OEM's own platform for A320 family, A220 and other Airbus fleets, aimed at fewer disruptions and better-planned maintenance.
